title: JEE Negative-Marking Form and Score Sheet
whatYouGet: A complete JEE-style Google Form script plus a submission trigger that calculates +4, -1 and blank-zero scores in a linked sheet.
howToUse: Set the syllabus and question count, audit each option independently, run the script, then test correct, wrong and blank submissions before sharing.
